planT-001-pageWidthStore.scope: One prefs key pageWidths; entries { value, unit(ch|px|%), themeOverride?, savedAt }; sanitize drops everything but finite positive integers, the three units and a non-empty-string theme id; 200-newest cap with deterministic path tie-break; tri-state missing-file prune (only a confirmed-missing file prunes); rename move flow mirroring filePositionStore/tableLayoutStore (serialized mutation queue, strict read so a failed read never becomes a write base); untitled and guide tabs (falsy pathname) are refused on save and load without any IO

planT-002-pageWidthPipeline.scope: resolveWidth document > theme > global naming the active source; parseWidth for the raw Appearance grammar; ch/px/% conversion on CH_TO_PX = 9.375 (the shipped 80ch = 750px identity) with % riding the live canvas; 10% preset snap onto UNIT_PRESETS plus nearestPreset anchor, isPresetValue, clampUnitValue, UNIT_BOUNDS; computeCanvasWidth = window − sidebar; computeRenderedBox = min(setting, canvas − 100px indent) with the 400px box floor, pure — the stored value is never mutated by clamping (corners C-2/C-3); resolveEffectiveWidth composer; computeAutoResizeTargetWidth = sidebar part + effective box as the recorded F-WINDOW-AUTO-RESIZE integration point (replaces the hardcoded 820 in store/layout.js when that feature revives — layout.js itself untouched, per spec R-3 it is a recorded dependency only)
planT-002-pageWidthPipeline.themeIntegration: util/theme.js addThemeStyle now ends with reapplyLastEditorWidth() (util/pageWidth.js): every theme stylesheet re-declares --editorAreaWidth, so the pipeline's inline value must be re-written after theme application; both orders (theme→width, width→theme) settle on the effective value — pinned by tests (review finding F1). setEditorWidth and the raw-preference path are byte-identical (baseline assertion text preserved). theme.js version bumped 2.1.0 → 2.2.0 with contract/map/summary updated
planT-002-pageWidthPipeline.writer: applyEditorWidth sets exactly one inline custom property (--editorAreaWidth) on the editor root — the % recompute on sidebar show/hide/drag is one property write per relayout, never a content re-render (corners C-3, finding F6); the host wiring (editor.vue sidebar watchers, per-document load/save hooks) belongs to the panel waves per the plan's task split and is NOT part of this wave
